title: 第21章 没让你诬陷别人第22章 白门
lines: “我这是在哪？”
若有若无的吆喝声回响在街巷，许平秋望着眼前被吃干净的面，陷入了沉思。
旋即他就想起，自己刚刚吃完了一碗面，现在该付钱走人了。
于是他在桌上留下一碗面的钱，起身就走。
但还没走出几步，面馆的老板就来到他面前，说道：“你吃了两碗面，还少给了一碗钱。”
许平秋懵逼了片刻，回头看了一眼，当即就指着自己刚刚的桌子说道：“我那桌上就一个碗，哪来的两碗面？”
但这话很快就引来了旁边男子的挤兑：“谁吃面上两个碗，那……”
“关你屁事？”许平秋打断他的逼逼赖赖，一副你谁，问你了嘛的神色。
“嘿你这年轻人，我这不是…”
被许平秋怼的男子虽然恼怒，但却仍要装出一副为他好的语气。
而许平秋却依旧用四字真经回怼道：“关我屁事？”
男子一时间有些语塞，但许平秋则继续说道：“问你了吗，你就说，长寿的秘诀是少管闲事，你这样很容易早逝。”
“吃面给钱，天经地义！”男子咬牙说道，此刻他的心态已经发生了微妙变化，从最开始碎嘴变成了想压许平秋一筹。
“怎么，你是老板养的狗？”许平秋像是有些狐疑的反问他。
“你凭什么这样说！”他的语气已经充满了愤恨，双眼死死的盯着许平秋。
“那你这么着急的狗叫什么？”许平秋一副看智障的眼神看着他。
短暂的沉默后，男子握紧了拳，开始了复读：“吃面给钱！”
许平秋则再度说出了令他破防的话：“狗再叫！”
正所谓简单的嘴臭极致的享受。
男子终于忍不住破防了，站起身狠狠的拍了一掌桌子，怒喝道：“你找死！”
但下一刻，许平秋就啪叽一下的躺在地上，开始浑身抽搐，但嘴里还中气十足的大喊道：
“救命啊，有人当街杀人啊！”
顿时，四面八方的目光聚焦而来，这令男子刚刚涌起的怒火瞬间被浇灭了，连忙摆手说道：“不是我干的，你们听我解释，他是装的，他只是不想付面钱！”
“你放屁！”
许平秋垂死病中惊坐起，捂着胸口，一副受重伤的模样，故作艰难的喊道：
“你又不是老板，这么关心面钱干嘛，就算我不想付面钱，你又凭什么打人！”
在许平秋的言语引导下，围观的百姓纷纷开始指着那名男子开始指指点点，令他百口莫辩。
顷刻间舆论逆转，这发展相当不对劲，给幻境外的姚元明等人都看傻了，这只能用震撼二字来形容了。
明明这情节设计的是让你被污蔑，考验你的信心，这怎么莫名其妙变成了污蔑别人？
而且这厮已经不能用牙尖嘴利来形容了，更重要的是，这货竟然一点下限都没有，直接就躺地上了。
姚元明不好评价许平秋的心性，但是从褚玉山的脸色上来看，嗯，很强，强的令人发指。
乐临清虽然没想到会是这样，但却并不意外，只能说这很许平秋。
就是作为设计者的褚玉山牙都快要碎了，万万没想到竟然有人能这样搞事。
他差点把自己下颌的胡子给揪了下来，但还是嘴硬道：
“呵呵，不愧是霁雪道君看重的人，心性果然…果然不同一般。”
意外，一定是意外，不可能再出现第二个许平秋。
褚玉山一边安慰着自己，一边捣鼓着水镜，让画面一转，不再去看许平秋，试图让自己血压降下来。
但下一刻，一头吊额白睛大虫出现在了画面中。
凳子有些懵逼的塞在它的屁股下，完全被白虎的皮毛给遮住了。
而老板按照程序走上前对着白虎说道：“你吃了两碗面，还少给了一碗钱。”
“嗷呜？”白虎听不懂意思，但是熟练的来了一套拜年剑法。
但旋即身旁的男子就开始添油加醋：
content_en:
"Where am I?"
Ruoyouruowu's shouts echoed in the streets. Xu Pingqiu looked at the clean noodles in front of him and fell into deep thought.
Then he remembered that he had just finished a bowl of noodles and now it was time to pay and leave.
So he left the money for a bowl of noodles on the table, got up and left.
But before he had taken a few steps, the owner of the noodle shop came to him and said, "You ate two bowls of noodles, but you still paid less for one bowl."
"Huh?"
Xu Pingqiu was confused for a moment, looked back, and immediately pointed to the table where he was just now and said: "There is only one bowl on my table, where did the two bowls of noodles come from?"
But these words soon attracted the attention of the man next to him: "Whoever eats two bowls of noodles, then..."
"It's none of your business?" Xu Pingqiu interrupted him, looking like who are you and why are you asking?
"Hey you young man, I'm not..."
Although the man who was criticized by Xu Pingqiu was angry, he still had to pretend to be good for him.
But Xu Pingqiu still used the four-character scripture to reply: "It's none of my business?"
"You..."
The man was speechless for a moment, but Xu Pingqiu continued: "Did I ask you? Just say that the secret of longevity is to mind your own business. It's easy for you to die early."
"It's only natural to give money to eat noodles!" The man gritted his teeth and said. At this moment, his mentality had undergone subtle changes. From the initial quarrel, he turned to wanting to outdo Xu Pingqiu.
"Why, are you the boss's dog?" Xu Pingqiu asked him suspiciously.
"Why do you say that!" His tone was full of resentment, and his eyes were fixed on Xu Pingqiu.
"Then what do you call the dog you are so anxious about?" Xu Pingqiu looked at him as if he was mentally retarded.
"..."
After a brief silence, the man clenched his fists and began to repeat: "You can pay for noodles!"
Xu Pingqiu once again said the words that broke his guard: "The dog barks again!"
As the saying goes, the ultimate enjoyment of simple bad breath.
The man finally couldn't help but break his guard. He stood up and slapped the table hard, shouting angrily: "You are looking for death!"
But the next moment, Xu Pingqiu lay on the ground and began to twitch all over, but he still yelled with great breath:
"Help, someone is killing someone in the street!"
Suddenly, eyes from all directions focused on him. The anger that had just surged up in the man was instantly extinguished. He quickly waved his hands and said, "I didn't do it. Please listen to my explanation. He was just pretending. He just didn't want to pay the price!"
"You fart!"
Xu Pingqiu sat up in shock while he was dying. He covered his chest and looked like he was seriously injured. He pretended to be struggling and shouted:
"You're not the boss, why are you so concerned about face money? Even if I don't want to pay face money, why do you beat someone!"
Under the guidance of Xu Pingqiu's words, the people watching began to point at the man, leaving him speechless.
In an instant, public opinion reversed. This development was quite wrong. Yao Yuanming and others outside the fantasy world were dumbfounded. This can only be described as shocking.
This plot is obviously designed to slander you and test your confidence. How come it inexplicably turns into slandering others?
And this guy can no longer be described as sharp-tongued and sharp-tongued. More importantly, this guy has no lower limit at all and just lies on the ground.
Yao Yuanming couldn't comment on Xu Pingqiu's character, but judging from Chu Yushan's face, well, he was very strong, outrageously strong.
Although Le Linqing did not expect this to happen, he was not surprised. He could only say that this was very Xu Pingqiu.
Even the designer Chu Yushan's teeth were about to break. He never expected that someone could do something like this.
He almost pulled off the beard on his chin, but he still said stubbornly:
"Haha, he is indeed someone whom Taoist Lord Jixue values. His character is indeed... extraordinary."
An accident, it must be an accident, there is no way that there will be another Xu Pingqiu.
While comforting himself, Chu Yushan fiddled with the water mirror to change the scene, no longer looking at Xu Pingqiu, trying to lower his blood pressure.
But the next moment, a large insect with a hanging forehead and white eyes appeared on the screen.
The stool was stuffed awkwardly under its buttocks, completely covered by the white tiger's fur.
The boss followed the procedure and walked up to Bai Hu and said, "You ate two bowls of noodles, and you were paid less for one bowl."
"Ouch?" Bai Hu didn't understand the meaning, but he mastered a New Year's greeting sword technique.
But soon the man next to him began to add insult to injury:
